title: Single-page portfolio for Harsh Bulchandani with top profile photo and minimal modern styling

requirements.text: Create a single-page portfolio UI with a clean, professional header that displays the uploaded image (IMG_20251225_164253.jpg) as the profile photo at the very top, centered.

quotes:
Use the uploaded image as the profile photo for this portfolio.
The image should be placed at the top of the portfolio in a clean, professional layout.

acceptanceCriteria: The profile photo is shown at the top of the page in a header section and is visually centered.
The profile photo loads from a static asset included in the frontend build (no backend fetch required).
The profile photo includes English alt text (e.g., "Profile photo of Harsh Bulchandani").

requirements.text: Apply CSS-only presentation enhancements to the profile photo area: a soft background blur behind the image container and a slight brightness increase, while keeping colors natural (do not modify the image file itself).

quotes: Enhance lighting slightly, keep skin tone natural, and apply a soft background blur for a polished look.

Do not alter the image itself; apply the following through CSS only:

• Soft background blur behind the image container
• Slight brightness increase using a CSS filter
• Keep colors natural

acceptanceCriteria: The blur effect is applied to the background behind the photo container (not destructively to the image file).
A subtle brightness/lighting increase is applied using CSS filters, without obvious color shifting.
No image editing pipeline is introduced; the original uploaded image remains unchanged on disk.

requirements.text: Render the portfolio content sections beneath the header in this order and with the exact English text provided: Name (Harsh Bulchandani), Tagline (Creative Editing • Content Writing • Graphic Design), About Me paragraph, Services I Offer (3 items), Why Choose Me (4 bullet points), Tools Used (Canva, MS Word, Google Docs), and Design Style description.

quotes:
Name: Harsh Bulchandani
Tagline: Creative Editing • Content Writing • Graphic Design

About Me:
I am a dedicated freelancer offering professional editing, content writing, and graphic design services. I focus on clear communication, clean visuals, and high-quality results to help clients present their work confidently.

Services I Offer:

Editing & Proofreading (documents, resumes, assignments)

Content Writing (captions, bios, posts)

Graphic Design (Canva designs, Instagram posts, thumbnails, reel covers)

Why Choose Me:

Professional & clean work

Fast delivery

Affordable pricing

Client-focused approach

Tools Used:
Canva, MS Word, Google Docs

Design Style:
Minimal, modern, and trustworthy.
Soft colors, clean fonts, and a professional freelancer aesthetic.

acceptanceCriteria: All specified sections appear on a single page beneath the header.
Section text matches the user-provided wording and punctuation (including the • separators in the tagline).
Services and Why Choose Me are presented as clear lists (bulleted or card/list format).

requirements.text: Implement the overall design style as minimal, modern, and trustworthy with soft pastel background colors, clean sans-serif typography, generous whitespace, and a mobile-friendly single-column layout.

quotes:
Design Style:
Minimal, modern, and trustworthy.
Soft colors, clean fonts, and a professional freelancer aesthetic.

Styling notes:
• Use soft pastel background colors
• Clean sans‑serif font
• Generous white space
• Mobile‑friendly single‑column layout

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile widths, content is readable and presented as a single column with comfortable spacing.
Typography is consistent and uses a clean sans-serif look across headings/body.
Background and component styling use soft, non-saturated pastel tones and ample whitespace.
No blue/purple-dominant theme is introduced unless required by the provided content (keep it neutral, soft, and professional).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be modified: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep the app as a single-page portfolio; no multi-page routing required.
Do not modify the uploaded image file; implement lighting/blur via CSS only.
nonGoals: Internet Identity authentication or any login flow.
Backend data models, persistence, or CRUD for portfolio content (content is static).
Real-time features, messaging, or external integrations.
